question: Do heuristic fragment yield estimates from EXP-INTEL-33945226776 match actual DOM extraction on live WebArena Docker pages, and is Method 1 (element-count) or aggregated median more predictive of live yield?
hypothesis: Live fragment yield on WebArena Docker pages will be within +/-0.10 of Method 1 (element-count) estimates for at least 2 of 3 tested site types (shopping M1=0.365, gitlab M1=0.484, wikipedia M1=0.517). Method 1 is the only heuristic method that models viewport coverage (0.45-0.65) and node pruning (0.06-0.15), making it the most conservative and most likely to approximate the full REQUIRES_TRANSFORM pipeline. If live yield deviates from M1 by >0.10 for >=2 site types, the heuristic method is not a reliable prior for corpus suitability decisions.
falsifier: Live fragment yield deviates from Method 1 estimates by >0.10 for >=2 of 3 site types, OR shopping yield <0.25 (well below M1 0.365), OR gitlab yield <0.35 (well below M1 0.484), OR wikipedia yield >0.60 (above all heuristic estimates), OR Docker deployment fails to produce valid accessibility tree observations for >=1 task, OR shopping yield < wikipedia yield (ranking inversion).
baselines: Method 1 (element-count) estimates from EXP-INTEL-33945226776: shopping 0.365, gitlab 0.484, wikipedia 0.517 — the only method modeling viewport coverage and node pruning
Aggregated median estimates from EXP-INTEL-33945226776: shopping 0.65, gitlab 0.60, wikipedia 0.517 — inflated by degenerate Method 2 (char-length, yields 1.0 for 5/6 site types)
Truncation sensitivity ratios from EXP-INTEL-33945226776: shopping 0.37, reddit 0.439, gitlab 0.471, shopping_admin 0.453, map 0.702, wikipedia 0.897
Synthetic adapter baseline from EXP-INTEL-33925056324: element_recall=1.0 on 100-element synthetic observations (tautological upper bound, not predictive of live performance)
Structural suitability baseline from EXP-INTEL-33528832113: S1-S5 5/5 structural suitability without observation-format measurement
positive_control: Shopping task (consumer-facing e-commerce) should have highest actual fragment yield due to structured product data with interactive elements. Expected: actual yield >0.30 based on M1 estimate of 0.365. Shopping yield must exceed wikipedia yield.
null_control: Wikipedia task (CMS, minimal interactive elements) should have lowest actual fragment yield among the three site types. Expected: actual yield <0.60 and wikipedia yield < shopping yield AND wikipedia yield < gitlab yield.
measurement_validity: WebArena Docker environment must be deployable and produce valid accessibility tree observations (obs['text'] + obs_nodes_info) for all 3 tasks
Each task produces at least 1 observation with non-empty accessibility tree text
Accessibility tree parsing via research/intel/webarena_adapter.py succeeds without errors for each observation
Formatted observation string length is measured before and after REQUIRES_TRANSFORM pipeline (viewport filtering, IGNORED_ACTREE_PROPERTIES pruning, truncation)
Yield is computed as: elements_surviving_transform / total_elements_in_observation
Truncation is measured at both UTTERANCE_MAX_LENGTH=8192 and max_obs_length=1920
Viewport filtering is measured with current_viewport_only=True (WebArena default) vs False
IGNORED_ACTREE_PROPERTIES pruning effect is measured by counting elements with pruned properties
Task selection follows parent recommendation: one shopping (product listing), one gitlab (project/repository view), one wikipedia (article page)
decision_rule: If actual yield deviates from M1 estimate by <=0.10 for >=2 site types AND shopping yield >0.30 AND gitlab yield >0.30 AND wikipedia yield < shopping yield AND wikipedia yield < gitlab yield AND Docker deployment succeeds for all 3 tasks: verdict = SUPPORTS. C-CROSSSITE and C-LLM-INHERIT move toward EXPERIMENTAL with caveat that 3-task sample is small. If shopping yield <0.25 OR gitlab yield <0.35 OR deviation from M1 >0.15 for >=2 site types OR wikipedia yield > shopping yield: verdict = FALSIFIES. 2-site corpus remains practical bound and Intel should assess VisualWebArena/Mind2Web as alternatives. If NOT SUPPORTS AND NOT FALSIFIES: verdict = MIXED, inconclusive, need larger task sample. If Docker deployment fails for >=1 task: verdict = MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
product_consequence_positive: If live yield matches M1 estimates within +/-0.10, Method 1 is validated as a reliable prior for corpus suitability. The 812-task WebArena corpus becomes suitable for C-CROSSSITE and C-LLM-INHERIT integration experiments. Product lane can proceed with REQUIRES_TRANSFORM implementation (estimated 324 LOC) knowing the corpus expansion value is real, not heuristic. Graph lane can design cross-site transfer experiments using WebArena tasks.
product_consequence_negative: If live yield deviates substantially from M1 estimates (especially if Method 1 is more accurate than aggregated median), the 812-task corpus expansion provides less value than assumed. Product lane should bound REQUIRES_TRANSFORM investment to 2-site corpus and assess whether VisualWebArena or Mind2Web offer better yield-per-task economics. Intel should prioritize alternative benchmark reconnaissance.
estimated_cost: Medium: requires Docker deployment (WebArena images ~5-10GB), 3 task executions with browser automation, accessibility tree extraction and analysis. Estimated 2-4 hours compute time. No LLM API calls required (observation extraction is deterministic).
expected_information_gain: Very high: resolves the central unknown from EXP-INTEL-33945226776 — whether heuristic yield estimates match live DOM extraction. This single experiment changes the product decision about whether to invest in REQUIRES_TRANSFORM for the 812-task corpus. A positive result (yield within +/-0.10 of M1) justifies corpus expansion; a negative result constrains to 2-site corpus and redirects Intel to alternative benchmarks.
